verses.text: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.
lines: Don’t boast about tomorrow;
for you don’t know what a day may bring.

verses.text: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.
lines: Let another man praise you,
and not your own mouth;
a stranger, and not your own lips.

verses.text: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.
lines: A stone is heavy,
and sand is a burden;
but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.

verses.text: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?
lines: Wrath is cruel,
and anger is overwhelming;
but who is able to stand before jealousy?

verses.text: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
lines: Better is open rebuke
than hidden love.

verses.text: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
lines: The wounds of a friend are faithful,
although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.

verses.text: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.
lines: A full soul loathes a honeycomb;
but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.

verses.text: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.
lines: As a bird that wanders from her nest,
so is a man who wanders from his home.

verses.text: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
lines: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart;
so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.

verses.text: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.
lines: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend.
Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster.
A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.

verses.text: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.
lines: Be wise, my son,
and bring joy to my heart,
then I can answer my tormentor.

verses.text: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
lines: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge;
but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

verses.text: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!
lines: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger.
Hold it for a wayward woman!

verses.text: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.
lines: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning,
it will be taken as a curse by him.

verses.text: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:
lines: A continual dropping on a rainy day
and a contentious wife are alike:

verses.text: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.
lines: restraining her is like restraining the wind,
or like grasping oil in his right hand.

verses.text: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
lines: Iron sharpens iron;
so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

verses.text: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.
lines: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit.
He who looks after his master shall be honored.

verses.text: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.
lines: Like water reflects a face,
so a man’s heart reflects the man.

verses.text: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.
lines: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied;
and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.

verses.text: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.
lines: The crucible is for silver,
and the furnace for gold;
but man is refined by his praise.

verses.text: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
lines: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain,
yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.

verses.text: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds:
lines: Know well the state of your flocks,
and pay attention to your herds:

verses.text: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.
lines: for riches are not forever,
nor does the crown endure to all generations.

verses.text: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.
lines: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears,
the grasses of the hills are gathered in.

verses.text: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.
lines: The lambs are for your clothing,
and the goats are the price of a field.

verses.text: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.
lines: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food,
for your family’s food,
and for the nourishment of your servant girls.
